description: A contemporary Scandinavian-Japandi kitchen photographed at standing eye-level with a wide lens, capturing a wide three-quarter corner view showing both the main kitchen wall and the adjacent island. The kitchen cabinetry is flat-panel in a warm pale gray linen or concrete-textured finish — floor-to-ceiling on the left wall with integrated built-in oven column, open shelving unit in the center alcove, and upper and lower cabinets throughout. Cabinet hardware is minimal matte dark bar pulls. The backsplash and kitchen island waterfall countertop are white marble with subtle gray veining. The island is a thick slab with a clean chamfered edge profile, styled with a small potted green plant. The main kitchen wall includes open light oak shelves in the alcove, styled with ceramics, glass canisters, potted trailing plants, wooden utensils, and a stainless kettle — a thoughtfully styled shelfie. The floor is wide-plank herringbone light oak parquet. In the foreground, a round warm oak coffee table and low round stool edge into frame, with a glass vase of white gypsophila and a magazine. Recessed downlights in the white flat ceiling provide cool overhead illumination. The overall palette is warm greige, white marble, and light oak.
